purpose: Explain conditional regular consumer pack-price associations and support new-product price comparisons within a validated chocolate category domain.

target.name: log_regular_gbp_per_100g
target.price_basis: Regular consumer tax-inclusive selling-pack price; displayed, promotional and reference/compare-at prices remain separate.

eligibility_gates.requirement: Reviewed seller-specific listing and exact physical-product/family relationships; unresolved duplicates/variants excluded.
Reviewed in-scope product and supported comparable group; mixtures/boundary/bundled non-chocolate goods excluded or modeled separately.
Reviewed positive total edible mass for the priced consumer pack, with unambiguous multipack basis and no unresolved conflict; no shipping-weight or count-only substitution.
Reviewed positive regular GBP pack price from a supported source representation; displayed/reference/promotional price alone is insufficient.
Reviewed consumer tax-inclusive basis; taxable flag alone does not establish tax inclusion.
Timezone-aware time of price/source observation; ingestion, product updated_at or derivation time does not replace observation time.
Reviewed source-listed availability for the price observation; source stock is not a test of regional delivery stock.
Predictor classifications reviewed with resolvable original evidence and supported unconditional scope; conditional, conflicting and unreviewed claims excluded or explicitly missing.
Training-only support, rank and coverage checks establish a validated group/domain; sparse/unidentifiable effects cannot be reported as reliable premiums.

observation_policy.unit: One eligible seller listing at a defined observed time.
observation_policy.duplicates: Repeated identical price evidence is consolidated; same physical product across different sellers remains separate.
observation_policy.repeats: For a cross-sectional study use one declared observation window/rule per listing; if repeated times are used, group dependency and avoid implicit weighting by number of captures.
observation_policy.partitions: Publish brand-shop and retail inputs separately; pooled modeling requires source_role context and validation stratified by source_role.
observation_policy.weights: Document any family/seller/repeated-observation weighting before fitting.

feature_selection.rule: Select a predeclared supported subset from candidate_predictors using training-only coverage, variance, collinearity and domain review; the full catalog is not an instruction to include 100 regressors.
feature_selection.text: Original ingredients, marketing/tasting text, images and identity identifiers excluded from the baseline feature regression.
feature_selection.qualifiers: Model only comparable qualifiers; cocoa exact/minimum and ingredient/product claims must not silently share a numeric/indicator meaning.
feature_selection.nutrition: Predeclare any supported nutrition subset; exclude redundant energy measures and unreviewed serving/as-prepared values.
feature_selection.multilabel: Reviewed recognized labels may use separate binary indicators; unknown/incomplete lists are missing, never all-zero absence.

model.baseline: Interpretable linear regression of log regular GBP/100g within a supported product group.
model.brand_effect: Product brand effect, separate from selling-source effect; interpreted conditionally with support/confounding diagnostics.
model.seller_effect: Retailer/brand-shop selling-source effect, separate from product brand; source_role retained.
model.confounding: When brand and seller are inseparable, do not label a coefficient as an isolated brand premium; pool/restrict or report non-identifiability.
model.regularization: If needed, predeclare ridge regularization and tune within training folds; publish penalty, effect interpretation and uncertainty method.
model.interactions: Use only predeclared interactions with sufficient training support; no automatic high-order interaction expansion.
model.size_effect: Reviewed total edible pack mass enters as natural log grams; it may explain price/100g size effects and is never recovered from target price.

preprocessing.fit_scope: Fit category encoding, references and observed numeric domains only on each training fold. Any future pooling/selection/tuning must also fit only training data.
preprocessing.active_missing_policy: Every active predictor is required and missing_policy=reject. The initial executable baseline does not impute or scale; unknown/conflict/not_applicable/unreviewed values fail eligibility.
preprocessing.numeric: Use declared identity/log transforms preserving interpretable units. Save training minimum/maximum and refuse out-of-domain prediction values.
preprocessing.categorical: Only reviewed known training-supported levels are encoded. Unknown/unseen levels are unsupported, and cannot be references.
preprocessing.constant_terms: Record constant columns as dropped; a constant presence/absence feature has no estimable price association.

reference_policy.name: training_mode
reference_policy.rule: For each categorical/presence predictor, choose the most frequent supported reviewed known training level; ties resolve by sorted canonical label. Save chosen level and support counts; unknown/conflict/not_applicable cannot be a reference.
reference_policy.brand_and_seller: Choose and save product-brand and selling-source references independently.
reference_policy.numeric: Identity terms use the declared unit without scaling; log terms explicitly use natural logarithm of that unit.
reference_policy.prediction: Use saved fitted references and transforms; never choose new references from test or prediction inputs.

preprocessing.future_extension: Optional predictors, missingness indicators, imputation, centering, rare-level pooling or penalties require an explicit versioned design change and train-only fit; the broad catalog does not enable them silently.

validation.split_unit: Reviewed physical product/family relationship group across all sellers, with every listing/capture of that group kept in one fold; relationships group validation without merging records.
validation.family_unknown: Unresolved family/physical-product relationship prevents a credible family-held-out score; do not assume seller listing IDs establish independence.
validation.time: When source times span a meaningful period, additionally evaluate a forward holdout; transformations are trained on past observations only.
validation.source: Report held-out errors and coverage separately for brand shops and retailers, and supported product groups/brands/sellers.
validation.baseline_comparison: Compare against a declared training-only group median or other simple baseline.
validation.uncertainty: Choose and document grouped bootstrap or another dependence-aware coefficient/prediction uncertainty method; distinguish coefficient confidence intervals from prediction intervals.
validation.support: Publish training/test group and listing counts, missingness, exclusions, level counts, rank/confounding diagnostics and tested domain.

retransformation.median: exp(predicted_log_price) estimates a conditional median under the log-error formulation; label it median.
retransformation.mean: A conditional mean requires a documented training-only bias correction, such as an estimated smearing factor; do not label exp(log_prediction) as mean.
retransformation.interval: Transform log prediction interval bounds and document how residual/dependence uncertainty was estimated.
retransformation.pack_price: Multiply predicted GBP/100g by reviewed proposed edible pack mass / 100; retain the pack-size predictor context.

insight_contract.association: Describe estimates as conditional price associations, never proof that an ingredient/claim causes a price change.
insight_contract.categorical_effect: Relative percentage = 100*(exp(coefficient)-1), compared with the saved reference, conditional on specified covariates and scope.
insight_contract.continuous_effect: For an identity-transformed term, declared change delta gives 100*(exp(coefficient*delta)-1). For a log-transformed term, compare positive quantities x1/x0 using 100*((x1/x0)**coefficient-1). Cocoa percentage points and relative percentage changes are distinct.
insight_contract.new_product: Require supported group/market/source context and reviewed feature definitions; flag unknown or out-of-domain inputs and report a prediction interval plus optional proposed-price comparison.
insight_contract.deferred: Demand, profit, causal effects, optimal price and value-for-money scoring are outside the current training contract.

cocoa_percentage_policy.meaning: Exact whole-product cocoa percentage; product scope must mean the complete edible pack/product, not an individual chocolate component or ingredient.
